reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment — exactly what is expected for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: 9.4(a) gives Ono 'the right (but not the obligation)' to Manufacture or dual-source, 9.4(b) frames Array's obligation as supplying 'Ono's reasonable requirements' (a Vendor-side commitment, which the rule expressly permits), and 6.3 ties royalties to actual Net Sales rather than any minimum annual royalty.

No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, minimum order or volume cap on Customer appears in the cited clauses; forecasting/ordering mechanics are deferred to a future Supply Agreement with no committed volumes here, and 13.2 provides a termination-for-convenience exit, so the preferred position is met.

The rationale correctly notes the non-refundable upfront licence fee and effort-based diligence obligations as observations rather than deviations, consistent with the instruction to note minor sub-elements in the rationale.
No actionable redline is required, and none was proposed, so there is no over-flagging or directional error to correct.
